title: EvoSkill-S1: Evolving Reusable Skills with Genetic-Inspired Operators
abstract: arXiv:2611.22610v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reusable skills allow language-model agents to accumulate and reuse problem-solving experience. However, most existing methods improve a skill bank only indirectly through rollout-driven accumulation and heuristic reflection, often resulting in shallow and weakly controlled updates. We present EvoSkill-S1, an RL-driven framework that instead treats reusable skills themselves as the direct objects of evolution. Given hard-negative failures, EvoSkill-S1 selects parent skills and transforms them into candidate child skills through five genetic-inspired operators: revision, cross-revision, mutation, dual-reflection, and crossover. Downstream task rewards train the skill evolver to generate more effective child skills, while evaluator-guided write-back selectively retains beneficial updates. translated_title: EvoSkill-S1：基于遗传启发算子的可复用技能演化
translated_abstract: 可复用技能使语言模型智能体能够积累并复用解决问题的经验。然而，现有的大多数方法只能通过基于 rollout 的经验积累和启发式反思来间接改进技能库，这往往导致更新浅层化且控制力较弱。我们提出了 EvoSkill-S1，一个由强化学习驱动的框架，它将可复用技能本身作为演化的直接对象。面对困难负例失败，EvoSkill-S1 选择父代技能，并通过五种受遗传学启发的算子将其转化为候选子代技能：修订、交叉修订、变异、双重反思和交叉重组。下游任务奖励用于训练技能演化器以生成更有效的子代技能，同时由评估器引导的回写机制选择性地保留有益的更新。互补技能库融合将特定于算子的技能库整合起来，以利用它们各自不同的恢复模式，而程序化技能接口支持……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 EvoSkill-S1 框架，首次将可复用技能本身作为演化的直接对象，利用五种遗传启发算子和强化学习信号对语言模型智能体的技能库进行深层、可控的进化，从而突破了以往仅靠 rollout 积累和启发式反思进行间接、浅层技能更新的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces EvoSkill-S1, an RL-driven framework that directly evolves reusable skills via five genetic-inspired operators, enabling deeper and better-controlled skill bank updates for language-model agents compared to indirect rollout-driven accumulation and heuristic reflection.
